name: Bibidi Bibidi!
description:
About This Game

Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardly roguelike deckbuilder with a wacky spell crafting system. Every slot in your spellbook activates a different part of the card, so order matters. Create your own unique spells that a little wizard will shout for you!

Combine cards strategically to adapt to every situation. Will you Bibidi Babidi Boo your foes into oblivion, Sim Sala Kadabra yourself to block and draw cards, or Higitus Figitus Presto everyone into tiny, harmless fleas?

Game Features

  • Familiar combat with plenty of surprises.
    Easy to learn for new players as well as fans of the genre, while breaking the mold in unpredictable ways. Mix 'n match different parts of each card to create the ideal spell to get you out of a pickle!

  • Become the Wisest Wizard. 
    Experiment with a myriad of cards, sigils, and characters to become the ultimate magic wielder. Rewards, events, and the shopkeeper all offer potential expansions to your build.

  • Explore an eccentric subterranean dungeon.
    Entombed deep within the earth, lies the Wishing Well. It promises your heart's innermost desires, but at what cost? Journey through a gauntlet of combat rooms and unusual encounters to reach its core.

  • Unlock content as you play.
    Your destiny is foretold in the Skymap! Unlock new cards and characters by spending currency you win by getting as far as possible.

  • Handcrafted dungeon synth playlist. 
    These underground halls reverberate with the nostalgic soundscape of 90s fantasy synthesizers. We cooked it ourselves!

Will you make it to the end? Can you find out what happened to your brethren? Are you the last wizard? There's only one way to find out. Bibidi Bibidi!
short_desc: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.
